sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall on Saturday at 15:00 in a third-versus-fourth clash. The Ramblers arrive in excellent form with a five-game unbeaten run and strong home record, while fourth-placed Eccleshall will be looking to upset the hosts and extend their own four-game winning streak. Both sides are level on 19 points, making this a crucial encounter in the promotion battle.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth (1st, 19 points) and Stafford Town (2nd, 19 points) remain locked together at the summit. Stafford face a tricky away trip to Cheadle Heath Nomads, while Bridgnorth are away at Brereton Social. Eccleshall's visit to Sandbach offers them a chance to break clear of the chasing pack with another win. Lower down, Shawbury United host Wolverhampton Casuals in a mid-table battle, New Mills travel to face Dawley Town, and Bilston Town host Market Drayton Town. Foley Meir entertain struggling Widnes Town (0 wins, 7 games) at Trentham Foods Stadium, Crewe host Wednesfield Community, Telford Town travel to Barnton, and Allscott Heath welcome Alsager Town (only 4 points from 9 games) to their ground.
